frontal_spatial_matrix.muzzle_spot_diameter: Solid spots on the anterior muzzle exhibit a diameter approximately 10-15% that of the total width of the nasal pad.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a wide, degraded black tracking collar with visible surface tearing and exposure of internal material on the lateral-ventral side; minor focal lesion on the dorsal bridge of the muzzle.
other_distinctive_markers: Open-mouth posture exposing the upper right canine and lower dentition; highly prominent white vibrissae extending from the mystacial pads.
